items.title: IDC brings Quanta into Claude and adopts Claude across the company
items.summary: IDC integrated Claude as part of its Quanta platform, and it has rolled Claude out across its own business

items.title: Introducing artifacts for legal work
items.summary: Claude for Legal now includes ready-to-use artifacts for legal work that teams can adapt with their own data and connectors, and share across the business.

items.title: Smart reports, surveys, and pooled group budgets for Claude Enterprise
items.summary: In many organizations, members have identified the unique work that Claude can unlock. The next step is expanding that work to every team.

items.title: Claude for Financial Advisors
items.summary: Financial advisors can now connect Claude to the custodians, portfolio platforms, CRMs, and planning tools they depend on, along with new skills tailored to the daily work of a financial advisor.

items.title: Expanding Claude for Nonprofits
items.summary: Our new Claude for Nonprofits plugin brings new skills to every verified nonprofit organization, taking on the operational work that stretches small teams across fundraising, marketing, and hiring.
